We’re so confident we’ll match you with the right mattress, you can take it home and sleep on it for 90 nights. Love it, or we will replace it with a different mattress.

Sleep Trial

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_divider color=”#A92115″ divider_weight=”2px” _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”10px||||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_divider][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.8em” ol_line_height=”1.8em” module_alignment=”center” custom_margin=”||||false|false” text_font_size_tablet=”17px” text_font_size_phone=”16px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” text_line_height_tablet=”1.8em” text_line_height_phone=”1.5em” text_line_height_last_edited=”on|phone” ol_line_height_tablet=”1.8em” ol_line_height_phone=”1.5em” ol_line_height_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{}”]

You wouldn’t run a marathon in a brand new pair of shoes, because they’re not broken in yet. Mattresses are very similar. Your new mattress needs time to adjust to your body, so we’re giving you this trial period to make sure every night’s sleep is exactly how you dreamed it.

Here are a few key ways to break in your mattress during your 90 nights to ensure it’s perfect:

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.8em” ol_line_height=”1.8em” module_alignment=”center” custom_margin=”||||false|false” text_font_size_tablet=”17px” text_font_size_phone=”16px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” text_line_height_tablet=”1.8em” text_line_height_phone=”1.8em” text_line_height_last_edited=”on|phone” ol_line_height_tablet=”1.8em” ol_line_height_phone=”1.6em” ol_line_height_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{}”]

  1. Let it breathe. It’s tempting to dress it up in new bedding, but give it a few hours to settle and get some oxygen flow.
  2. Put on the pressure. Try walking around on it gently or using your hands and feet to apply some pressure to loosen it up.
  3. Bring on the heat. This is especially important if your new mattress is memory foam. Heat helps it soften up even more.
  4. Be patient. It’ll take some time for it to adjust to your body, usually around a month. Sleep on it every night so your mattress can get to know you.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” custom_padding=”||15px||false|false” hover_enabled=”0″ sticky_enabled=”0″][et_pb_column _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” type=”4_4″][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”15px” ol_line_height=”1.8em” module_alignment=”center” custom_margin=”||||false|false” hover_enabled=”0″ text_font_size_tablet=”17px” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” text_line_height_tablet=”1.8em” text_line_height_phone=”1.2em” text_line_height_last_edited=”on|phone” ol_line_height_tablet=”1.8em” ol_line_height_phone=”1.5em” ol_line_height_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

90-NIGHT COMFORT GUARANTEE – Your new mattress will take time to adjust to your body. You should sleep on it for a minimum of 30 nights to allow for this adjustment period. However, in the event that you are not comfortable within 90 nights from your original mattress’s delivery date, we will do our best to match you to the right mattress. You may exchange your Tempur-Pedic or Sealy Conform mattress without any restocking fee. (Exchange must be at least equal to 50% of the original purchase price) You may exchange all other mattresses with a restocking fee of $149.00. A mattress protector must be purchased along with your mattress purchase to receive the 90-day comfort guarantee. We are unable to exchange any mattress that is stained, made unsanitary, or otherwise damaged by you under the 90 Night Comfort Guarantee. We highly recommend using a waterproof mattress protector to help keep your new mattress sanitary. Do not remove the law tag from the mattress or foundation; removing the law tag will void the 90 Night Comfort Guarantee. Subject to the above restrictions, our 90 Night Comfort Guarantee is valid for 1 exchange, which must occur during the 90-day period from the original mattress delivery date. Please note that our 90 Night Comfort Guarantee is not valid on warranty exchanges, clearance merchandise, floor models, pillows, mattress protectors, power/adjustable bases, furniture, or other accessories.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]
